description: Conservative Tab 4 origin-candidate list. Entries are user-supplied candidates for linguistic verification, not verified etymologies. The intended research workflow is Kannada-to-English dictionary meaning followed by Alar lookup; record evidence before promoting any entry to verified status.
verificationWorkflow: Find the accepted Kannada headword in a Kannada-to-English dictionary.
Use its English gloss to search Alar; do not search Alar for the Kannada headword and treat that as independent proof.
Record the exact Alar entry and relevant meaning before changing evidenceStatus to verified.
